summary:
Beyond the Infinity is a digital space museum created to explore the history, purpose, and scientific importance of space equipment that has traveled beyond Earth. Our project presents exhibits about the Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP), Lunar Roving Vehicle, Lunar Module Descent Stage, and Mars exploration technology.
Through original NASA images and informative descriptions, we explain how these machines were designed, how they worked, and what they contributed to space exploration. We also highlight how data and discoveries from these missions continue to help humanity understand the Moon, Mars, and our solar system.
Our goal is to make space history interesting and accessible to students and young space enthusiasts while showing how past technology continues to shape future exploration.
details: The Lunar Legacy is a digital space museum that tells the stories behind NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars. Visitors explore virtual exhibits to discover the technology, science, and history of the hardware left behind by past missions.By turning technical mission archives into an interactive museum experience, our project makes space history accessible, engaging, and educational for students and enthusiasts worldwide. We designed and built the platform using Canva and NASA's open data, focusing on visual clarity, historical accuracy, and creative storytelling so anyone can easily explore humanity's footprint beyond Earth.
